item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 20/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea tomorrow. Showers will be heavy at times. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve and it will be very hot over Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week. Meanwhile, winds will be weak over the region. High temperatures may also trigger showers. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Jongdari will move across the Yellow Sea towards the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula, and continue to weaken today and tomorrow.
